title: Failed chain actions without exact restart authority cannot reserve another build
steps: Run the chain handoff suite with real PostgreSQL and check both refused and permitted explicit retries.
expect: A failed parent and failed stored QA cannot authorize Retry after lost placement, a successful write or another active writer.
Refusal leaves daily usage, the site brief and the action count unchanged.
Valid historical and failed-child retries retain exact generation authority and restart once without provisioning another site.
fence: The current owned chain generation must authorize acceptance before the daily usage reservation.

tests: a failed chain action cannot reserve a no-op Retry for lost-applying
a failed chain action cannot reserve a no-op Retry for lost-placement
a failed chain action cannot reserve a no-op Retry for successful-write
a failed chain action cannot reserve a no-op Retry for live-writer
an explicit historical chain Retry preserves the old verdict and resumes the same failed generation once
a failed child Retry receives fresh authority for its own failed chain generation
